question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
-- Final answer
WITH constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name, SUM(res.points) as total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND res.points > 0
    GROUP BY r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name
),
min_points_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_season_points
    GROUP BY year
),
least_constructors AS (
    SELECT csp.year, csp.constructor_id, csp.name, csp.total_points
    FROM constructor_season_points csp
    JOIN min_points_per_year mpy ON csp.year = mpy.year AND csp.total_points = mpy.min_points
)
SELECT name, COUNT(*) as season_count
FROM least_constructors
GROUP BY name
ORDER BY season_count DESC, name ASC
LIMIT 5
